overview: The School Committee finalized several year-end personnel contracts, approved a new five-year student transportation agreement with a preliminary electrification planning phase, and set rates for a new after-school early-pickup option. The committee also initiated an accessibility assessment of building entries and referred several comprehensive health and safety policies to subcommittee for further review.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine bills, payroll, capital purchases, grants, meeting minutes, and local donations including a $1,500 scholarship.

items.title: Introduction of New Administrative Staff
items.summary: Introduced Dr. Kimberly Talbot as Assistant Superintendent of Curriculum and Instruction and Chelsea McNiff as Director of English Learners.

items.title: CCSR Annual Report
items.summary: Received a presentation on student-led community service projects and discussed the need to recruit a high school advisor to bolster participation.

items.title: Yellow Bus Transportation and Electrification
items.summary: Approved a five-year contract with Eastern Bus and referred a city-led school bus electrification feasibility study to the Strategic and Capital Planning Subcommittee.

items.title: After-School Programming Early Pickup Rate
items.summary: Approved a new $15 daily rate for a 4:00 p.m. early-pickup option designed to increase program capacity and offer flexibility for families.

items.title: Water Filling Station Lease
items.summary: Approved a five-year lease for "Flow Water" premium filtration units to be installed in cafeterias, which includes ongoing maintenance coverage.

items.title: Personnel Contracts and Wage Increases
items.summary: Approved a three-year contract for Teamsters administrators, a consulting contract for the budget analyst, and wage increases for non-unit personnel.

items.title: Allergy and Field Trip Policies
items.summary: Referred new comprehensive policies regarding life-threatening allergies and field trip procedures to the Rules and Policy Subcommittee for refinement.

items.title: Rescission of Outdated MCAS Policy
items.summary: Rescinded policy IKFC-MCAS to avoid conflicts with current graduation standards and state assessment regulations.

items.title: Shore Collaborative Update
items.summary: Formally received the quarterly update from the Shore Educational Collaborative as required by regulation.

items.title: Building Accessibility Assessment Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring an evaluation of building entry points for ADA accessibility concerns, with a report due by the end of fall.

items.title: Designer Selection Panel Appointment
items.summary: Appointed Jenny Graham to the MSBA Designer Selection Panel for the new comprehensive high school building project.

items.title: Disciplinary Practice Reporting
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring the superintendent to provide a detailed, disaggregated report on student suspensions and disciplinary actions by October 31, 2025.
